result.minute: about 20:40: the records end at 20:43 with commander_t1 at 22% health at H2 among 22 enemy soldiers; commander_t3 died 19:18 at G5, commander_t2 20:05 at H7 (the ledger: about 20:30)

summary: Irishstud14 declared 'I greed then' (0:27) and took naked extractors behind Rascal raids, while our three seats opened slowly (3-4 solars before the plant, 7-9 factory units by 4:00 against the pool's p25 of 16-17) and kept their first soldiers as pickets on our strip, the constructors fenced out of his half and the commanders out of the middle. thebluegecko, spectating, called it from 3:58 to 5:53 ('almost caught up to the three claude players by building naked mexes', 'an aggressive response is needed'); our raiders first crossed at 6:32-7:20 and the north and middle groups pushed his main base at B3 on hold-line, where Pounders from 8:10 broke the Blitzes (about 25 lost on seat 0, 11 of them on a retreat through the Pounder line at 9:02-9:19). The middle game was even: Lashers, then Brutes and Pounders on his advice, and a 9k three-group strike on his commander at D3 (11:59-13:27) that killed his escort but let him walk away. From 13:22 swarms of 10-18 Incisors slipped past the slower Brute ball and took our extractors from 31 to 11 by 17:00, his Graverobbers raised our Stouts from the unreclaimed E3 wreck field from 17:28, the army collapsed at F3 (17:37-18:18) and two commanders died by 20:05. Counted once per death across the three records, the fights were about even (our army lost 37.8k against his 42.4k seen) and the whole trade was lost (62.4k against 44.7k): one person out-produced three seats, as thebluegecko put it at 18:57, 'irish expanded faster than the three claude bots, even fight on first contact'.

root.what: Against an opponent who had announced a greedy opening, the player turned the first soldiers of every seat into pickets on our own extractors (stations from 2:07 and 2:58), barred the commanders from the middle columns (3:13) and the constructors from 32 spots of his half (4:10), on top of a metal-starved opening whose plants 'idle on metal' (its own 3:13 note). So the first window, 2.3-6.9x his seen army on every seat at 4:00-5:00, was spent at home while he took naked extractors, and our expansion stayed on the strip. The cause is the person's reading (3:58, 4:22, 18:57); the orders behind it are from the transcript.
root.evidence: minutes.py 4:00-5:00 windows, our mass in his half peak 0% (t1), 5% (t2), 0% (t3); 3:13 standing commander never spot_32 ... spot_1; 4:10 constructors never 32 western spots; thebluegecko 3:58 'Irish has almost caught up to the three claude players by building naked mexes.'

their_play: Irishstud14 (Cortex) opened greedy by his own word ('I greed then', 0:27): naked extractors in the middle and his half (thebluegecko at 3:58; his first Guard seen at 5:16, at B8), and Rascal swarms (10 seen at 2:58, 29 killed) raiding our outer spots from 3:53 to 6:22. Incisors from 6:52 (100 seen killed), Brutes from 7:13 (64), Pounders from 8:10 (59), all from vehicle plants; the Pounders met our push at his main base and then roamed our north in pairs (10:11-11:40); Guards beside his forward extractors and at E4; his commander forward at D3 at 11:50 with Brutes and Guards, walking away from three groups. From 13:22 he raided in three or four parties, the biggest 14-18 Incisors, choosing our outer and southern extractors over our ball; from 17:28 Graverobbers reclaimed and resurrected at E3 (our Stouts fought for him from 17:39), Twin Guards at E4. No tier 2 and no aircraft were seen. His army seen at any one time never passed 4,070 (18:00), yet his army seen killed or standing (42.4k killed, 1.5k of it our resurrected Stouts and Blitzes, plus 2.9k seen at 20:00) exceeds all the army our three seats lost or held at the end (37.8k + about 1.3k): one person out-produced three seats.

tools: record and enemy_seen scans by python
lens.existing_review: none (the match directory has posing-review.md and decompression-review.md, model audits of 2026-09-27, but no review.md)
lens.caveats: No truth file and no batch.json/results.jsonl: his numbers are floors. analyze_match, minutes, raid_ledger and hands_window read only the first record/jev file, so seats t2 and t3 were read through scratch links (record-1/2 as record-0). raid_ledger's 'answered 0' is a tool artifact: its regex drops the _t<team> suffix (the posing review's corrected count: 10/15, 12/17, 22/24). The match directory holds two model reviews (posing-review.md, decompression-review.md, 2026-09-27), no review.md; I differ from the posing review's headline that most of the loss traces to what the menus could express: the person's reading and the tools put the root at 2:07-4:10 in the player's own orders, and the menu gaps raise the cost from 13:00. The ledger's 'seen trade 85k to 30k in our favour' (his side corrected to 44.7k) understates our losses: by unit id over the three records ours were 62.4k. pro_baseline's pool for t3 (G4 Cortex) is 3 sides. Date: the record's local clock is 2026-09-26 21:39 EDT (2026-09-27 UTC), the ledger's day. Chat speakers are '?'; attribution follows lessons.md. Process note, not about the game: for about a minute (00:18-00:19 local) my per-seat links sat in the shared scratchpad's seat1/ and seat2/, which the bluegecko-3v1-comet-catcher-6 reader had just made; I removed them, but a tool that reader ran on seat1/ or seat2/ in that minute read this game's records.
